Items.Name: Key of Bronze
Items.Description: Opens the bronze passage on dungeon level 2. Without it the party is pushed back.

Items.Name: Key of Silver
Items.Description: Opens the silver passage on dungeon level 2. Without it the party is pushed back.

Items.Name: Key of Gold
Items.Description: Found beneath the bronze statue on dungeon level 2.

Items.Name: Statue of Bear
Items.Description: Needed to pass the bear door on dungeon levels 2 and 4.

Items.Name: Statue of Frog
Items.Description: Needed to pass the frog door on dungeon level 2.

Items.Name: Blue Ribbon
Items.Description: Given by Trebor. Makes the elevator on dungeon level 4 accessible.

Items.Name: Amulet of Werdna
Items.Description: The Mad Overlord's stolen amulet. It is cursed, so never wear it. The bearer regains 1 HP with every step, and using it casts Malor to return the party to town. Returning it to the surface earns 50,000 XP and 50,000 GP.
